<b>My Missing Brother</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== How to Start ==
The Wish can be acquired from [[Bellhart|Bellhart's]] [[Wishwall]] after completing the <i>[[My Missing Courier]]</i> Wish and either accepting the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> Wish or speaking to the [[Caretaker]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Frey 01.png!Wishwall location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Frey 01.png!Wishwall in Bellhart
}}

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must find [[Pill]]'s location within the central part of [[Sinner's Road]]. Parts of Pill's cargo are scattered around [[Greymoor]] and Sinner's Road, which can be interacted with to track his pathway.

At this location, Pill is hiding from a [[Roachfeeder]] and a [[Roachcatcher]], who have to be defeated to save him and return him to Bellhart.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Pill My Missing Brother.png!Pill's location in Sinner's Road
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Tipp & Pill 03.png!Pill in Sinner's Road
}}

== Reward ==
After completing the Wish, Tipp and Pill are reunited in Bellhart and start giving out [[Delivery Wishes]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Tipp & Pill 01.png!Location of Couriers Tipp & Pill in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Tipp & Pill 04.png!Couriers Tipp & Pill in Bellhart
}}
